newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values thin, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values thin, wheat steady.

text.p: FOB Gulf soybean basis values were not quoted for nearby shipment because rain-delayed harvest in the U.S. Midwest has made it difficult to supply soybeans to shippers, dealers said.
Corn basis values were steady for nearby October positions but were down in deferred slots amid light buyer interest.
Taiwanese buyers are expected to hold four tenders for a total of 104,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans and 88,000 tonnes of corn next week.
A slowdown in export demand for wheat has kept basis values steady. Wheat supplies in export channels were light but were sufficient to handle the light export demand, they said.
